name: Exp_FisherCyberCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the FisherCyberCycle custom indicator, generating buy signals when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and supports independent control of position opening and closing for both buy and sell directions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于FisherCyberCycle自定义指标进行交易，当指标线上穿信号线时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号。它采用可配置的资金管理系统，支持多种保证金模式，并可独立控制多空方向的开仓和平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于FisherCyberCycle指标，这是一种将Fisher变换应用于网络周期（CyberCycle）振荡器的技术指标，旨在产生更平滑、更锐利的转折信号。入场条件为：当指标线（Ind）高于信号线（Sign）且前一根K线上指标线低于或等于信号线时开多仓；当指标线低于信号线且前一根K线上指标线高于或等于信号线时开空仓。出场条件同样基于指标交叉信号，当多头信号消失时平多仓，空头信号消失时平空仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1，配合MMMode选择计算方式。EA还采用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复交易，但仅在SignalBar为0时或新K线出现时才重新计算信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the FisherCyberCycle indicator, which applies the Fisher Transform to a CyberCycle oscillator to produce smoother and sharper turning point signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator line (Ind) is above the signal line (Sign) and the previous bar's indicator line was at or below the signal line; a sell position opens when the indicator line is below the signal line and the previous bar's indicator line was at or above the signal line. Exit conditions are also based on indicator crossovers: long positions close when the bullish signal disappears, and short positions close when the bearish signal disappears, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, combined with MMMode to select the calculation method. The EA also employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading within the same bar, recalculating signals only when SignalBar is 0 or a new bar appears.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling trade ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（可用保证金/余额/扣浮亏保证金/扣浮亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: MM mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引（0=当前bar，1=前一bar）

pros: Fisher变换使信号更加锐利，减少了传统振荡器的滞后性
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
多空方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，策略配置灵活度高
设有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Fisher Transform produces sharper signals, reducing lag typical of traditional oscillators
Supports multiple money management modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences
Buy and sell direction opening and closing can be independently controlled, offering high configuration flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated position opening within the same bar
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标FisherCyberCycle，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整
缺乏加仓和减仓机制，无法在趋势中优化仓位
未进行持仓检查，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
指标参数Alpha和Length缺乏自适应机制，在不同市场状态下可能表现差异较大
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator FisherCyberCycle; EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
Stop loss and take profit are fixed points without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
Lacks position scaling mechanisms (add/reduce), unable to optimize positions during trends
No existing position check before opening new trades, potentially leading to duplicate positions in the same direction
Alpha and Length parameters lack self-adaptive mechanisms, performance may vary significantly across different market conditions
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
增加交易时间过滤和点差过滤，避免在不利的交易环境下开仓
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate opening in the same direction which leads to overexposure
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Add trading session filter and spread filter to prevent opening positions in unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 未检查已有同向持仓，可能导致同方向重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在剧烈波动时止损可能过小导致频繁被扫
依赖外部指标文件，若指标计算异常可能产生错误信号
risk_points_en: No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate openings that increase risk exposure
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility; tight stops may be frequently triggered during volatile periods
Depends on external indicator file; abnormal indicator calculations could produce erroneous trading signals

It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and supports independent control of position opening and closing for both buy and sell directions.
